messages:
sam: Heads up — we just noticed a gap in paging from incident-bot for ~30m. customer-reported errors during that window. Notifying oncall and starting triage.
incident-bot: automated alert: webhook_delivery_failure rate spike detected (500s) -> throttling engaged. details in logs.
maria: WTF. which oncall was supposed to get paged?
jonathan: sam is current oncall. i didn't get a page either. i saw the alert in the channel but no pager.
sam: i saw a channel alert at 15:02 but no page until 15:34 when eli manually paged me. customer impact: staging and a handful of users in eu-prod.
tanaka: ops-bot is showing repeated 502/504s from the incident-bot -> pagerbridge endpoint. looks like backpressure on the webhook queue.
ops-bot: recent webhook errors (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-17T15:01:02Z] POST /webhook/pagerbridge 502 response_time=1203ms body="upstream reset"
[2026-03-17T15:05:11Z] POST /webhook/pagerbridge 504 response_time=4500ms body="timeout"
[2026-03-17T15:18:09Z] POST /webhook/pagerbridge 429 response_time=30ms body="rate_limited"
```
eli: i manually escalated at 15:33 to avoid customer impact. we should record that as manual page and include in postmortem.
maria: mitigation steps? can we disable throttling on incident-bot temporarily?
jonathan: don't flip throttles blindly; need to ensure pagerbridge isn't overwhelmed. plan: 1) temporary manual pages for active incidents 2) scale pagerbridge workers (tanaka) 3) investigate root cause of 502/504 4) add alert if webhook queue > 500 messages.
tanaka: scaling up pagerbridge by +3 workers now. ETA ~6m. i'll tail logs and post anything anomalous.
incident-bot: state change: throttling still active — queue depth 712 -> dropping non-critical pages.
sam: ok thanks. eli/tony, please confirm manual pages sent for affected customers and attach convo links. i'll start an incident doc.
eli: confirmed manual pages to oncall at 15:33 and 15:36. customers notified via support channels.
maria: can we add a fallback to SMS gateway directly if webhook fails? low risk but faster. file a follow-up ticket.
jonathan: agreed. post-incident actions: add runbook section for webhook backpressure, add a canary that sends a test page every 5m, and ensure incident-bot exposes a "force-page" API that bypasses queue for severity=1.
ops-bot: pagerbridge workers scaled +3, queue clearing — depth now 120 at 15:42.
sam: last ask before we close this live thread: capture exact window for SLA reporting. i'll update the incident channel and tag support/ops for customer comms.
incident-bot: final automated log at 15:44: webhook_error_rate returned to baseline.
jonathan: moving to postmortem channel after doc draft. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
